'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 WIRFS LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Wirfs]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
